title: Crate Digger: Curated Independent Record Labels
description: An initial exploration territory of curator-led independent record labels. Reach tier measures historical or market reach, not artistic quality. The dataset is designed for filtering, graph traversal, recommendation explanations, and later entity resolution against MusicBrainz and Discogs.

reach_tier.canonical: Historically transformative institution with broad international recognition.
reach_tier.major-tastemaker: Established contemporary independent label with international reach.
reach_tier.specialist: Recognized label with a defined musical or scene territory.
reach_tier.boutique-caviar: Small or focused imprint whose catalogue provides an unusually strong curatorial signal.
reach_tier.legacy: Inactive or historically transformed label whose catalogue remains essential for musical genealogy.

curatorial_strength.exceptional: The label name itself is a powerful recommendation and inference signal.
curatorial_strength.very-high: A strong aesthetic identity persists across most of the catalogue.
curatorial_strength.high: A recognizable identity exists, with meaningful stylistic breadth.

integration_guidance.important_note: Do not interpret reach_tier as a quality ranking. Use curatorial_strength and label_signal when estimating discovery value.
integration_guidance.claim_policy: Store future factual enrichment as claims with source, retrieval date, and confidence rather than overwriting curated interpretation without evidence.
integration_guidance.exploration_frontier: Labels referenced as useful next-hop candidates but not yet modeled as full entities in this seed.
